newsitem.title: USA: Mecklenburg Cty, N.C, creates bond oversight board.
newsitem.headline: Mecklenburg Cty, N.C, creates bond oversight board.

text.p: North Carolina's Charlotte-Mecklenburg County School Board voted Tuesday to create a bond oversight panel ahead of a major bond referendum.
The five-member panel would keep residents apprised of how local bond proceeds are spent and would also make recommendations about future projects.
Members are to be appointed by the school board and superintendent in July, and will be prohibited from having any professional involvement in school district bond deals.
Mecklenberg County residents will vote on Nov. 4 on a proposal to issue $500 million of general obligation bonds for schools.
